4th Period.workingNow: Creating your GitHub account and getting it fully set up.
4th Period.weeklyDeliverable: GitHub account created, starter repo forked, and GitHub Pages live with your first name and one image on the home page — no other personal info.
4th Period.smartGoal: I can create a GitHub account so that I have a workspace ready to build on.
4th Period.contentStandard: CA CS Standards 6-8.IC.24 — Compare tradeoffs between allowing information to be public and keeping information private and secure.
4th Period.eldStandard: ELD.PI.6-8.6 — Reading closely and explaining orally how an author uses language to support ideas.
agenda: Warm-Up: What is GitHub & why do we use it? PII reminder (8 min)
I do: teacher creates a demo account step-by-step (7 min)
We do: create your account together, one step at a time (15 min)
You do: finish account setup & verify your email (15 min)
Exit Ticket: Show your account username to a partner for a check (5 min)
4th Period.connections: On Monday we got our classroom tools set up, but we didn't get to GitHub yet. Today we make sure every single person has a working account before we touch any code. Tomorrow we'll use that account to fork our starter repo.

6th Period.workingNow: Building the home page of your Google Site and adding one image.
6th Period.weeklyDeliverable: Google Site home page live with a nav menu and one image, and the Getting to Know You survey submitted.
6th Period.smartGoal: I can create a home page on my Google Site and add an image so that my site has a starting point I can build on.
6th Period.contentStandard: CA CS Standards 6-8.AP.13 — Decompose problems and subproblems into parts to facilitate the design, implementation, and review of programs.
6th Period.eldStandard: ELD.PI.6-8.6 — Reading closely and explaining orally how an author uses language to support ideas.
agenda: Warm-Up: What makes a good home page? (5 min)
I do: teacher models creating a page and adding an image (8 min)
We do: navigate to Google Sites together, open the template (7 min)
You do: build your home page & insert one image (25 min)
Exit Ticket: Share your site link in Google Classroom (5 min)
6th Period.connections: Yesterday we learned our classroom routines and tools. Today you start building your own website — the home page you make today is the first thing visitors will see all year. Next class we'll make it navigable.
